register_dataset: register a dataset config section and dependency injection bindings for a named dataset in a Fairseq2 DependencyContainer
register_dataset_open: register a dataset opener that resolves a DatasetSection and returns a _DatasetHolder via the container resolver
register_dataset_get: register a singleton dataset object resolver that extracts the dataset from a _DatasetHolder in the container
register_default_dataset: register the default dataset section and _DatasetOpener type in a Fairseq2 DependencyContainer for recipe composition
register_default_dataset_holder: register a default non-keyed _DatasetHolder resolver that resolves the dataset section from the container
